notes.title: Game System Update (20250321)
notes.content:
In this version, the game system has been comprehensively upgraded.

Association Hints (Enabled by default)
When you have collected all the clues available for association, the system will prompt you that there are currently associable contents.
Added Automatic Association Function (Disabled by default, experimental)
This function is provided for story-oriented players. As long as you collect clues that can be associated, new clues can be automatically synthesized.
This function is disabled by default each time the game is opened and needs to be manually enabled in the game's settings menu.

notes.title: 2022/2/24 update instructions
notes.content: Fixed several bugs and added multiple languages

notes.title: 更新:修复Bug,增加更多破案工具
notes.content:
感谢玩家的热情支持，根据玩家反馈，进行了一次修补
1.修复了无法获得成就的BUG
2.修复了若干界面BUG
另外还有新玩家反应，借助线索雷达和线索分析仪无法顺利破案，我对破案工具进行了加强
1.线索雷达增加了可关联性探测，如果已经搜证的线索可以关联时，雷达将会提示玩家有可关联线索
2.线索分析仪进行了加强，给出了进一步的关联提示
3.增加了“线索隐藏”辅助工具，分析线索时候面对40条有点多，可以把确定没用的隐藏掉，看起来舒服一些，请大家测试。

最后，大家如果有什么意见，请在评测区给我写出，我会看，然后改进。

祝各位侦探身体健康！
